cards.scope: Complete the XLM parity and threat model
cards.evidenceText: Design decision: use one Stellar account per vault, funded and activated by the user's wallet through CreateAccount. Connected-wallet support for this flow remains to verify, and XRC XLM/USD live source quorum is unproven. Separately, a read-only mainnet XRP config check on 2026-10-27 returned Active, a $30,000 debt ceiling (3,000,000,000,000 e8s), and an explicit Linear rate curve. Decoded live values are a 128% borrow threshold, 117% liquidation ratio, 7.5% liquidation bonus, 0.2% borrowing fee, 1.5% base APR, and 132.266666666666666624% recovery target. Those differ from the XRP source constructor's $2,500 ceiling and 150%/133%/12% parameters; do not present constructor values as current live parity. XRP evidence only; no XLM registration, deployment, or live config is proved.

cards.scope: Build the Stellar rail and independent address and transaction vectors
cards.evidenceText: Typed read-only Horizon wrappers and persistent deposit state are present. The last focused `chains::stellar` Cargo suite passed 34/34 and deposit-state migration test passed 1/1 before the final 10B cycle-budget edit and commit 011c0b72; the backend library check was also before the route guards. The generic route change received source-only review, not Cargo tests/build. Wrappers have made no actual Horizon outcall, and stored deposit/receipt maps are not used by a live flow. Snapshot consistency and single-provider trust remain unresolved. No vault/deposit/claim lifecycle, XLM registration, deployment, or collateral admission is proved.

cards.scope: Add stable state and an XLM launch guard
cards.evidenceText: A source scaffold adds a Frozen NativeXlm config constructor that clones risk/curve fields from a supplied current XRP config, sets XLM to 7 decimals and a 1 XLM minimum, and clears observations. State config tests passed 2/2 and legacy custody decode passed 1/1 before the latest route change. Generic update_collateral_config rejects both the canonical XLM key and NativeXlm. Persistent serde-defaulted XlmPendingDeposit state and a permanent `(tx hash, operation id)` receipt map were added; their CBOR round-trip/old-snapshot default test passed 1/1. An independent read-only review found no stable-upgrade blocker but noted these maps are unused by a live deposit flow. Config remains Frozen; XLM is not registered, deployed, or admitted as collateral.

cards.scope: Implement verified XLM deposits and borrowing
cards.evidenceText: Commit 011c0b72 adds source-reviewed fail-closed guards for generic ICRC open/add/sweep, redemption candidates, Stability Pool quote/write-down, and main generic SP/3USD/bot entrypoints via is_native_external; dedicated XRP claim/absorb paths are untouched. However, XRP-only withdrawal/close/manual-liquidation payout branches still fall through to ICRC if XLM becomes Active. The implementation plan requires routing NativeXlm away from ICRC add/deposit endpoints before ledger calls (`docs/plans/native-xlm-collateral-2026-10-27.md:86`). Cargo tests/build have not rerun after this route change. Frozen config and generic update denial keep XLM unreachable now; WP3 remains blocked and no XLM deposit/borrow lifecycle or admission is proved.

cards.scope: Implement XLM claims, exits, and liquidation handling
cards.evidenceText: Commit 011c0b72 adds reviewed fail-closed checks to generic custody routes; the dedicated XRP claim/absorb paths remain unchanged. Remaining XRP-only withdrawal/close/manual-liquidation payout branches would fall through to ICRC if XLM became Active, so WP4 remains blocked. The plan requires custody-aware withdrawal/close guards and guarded manual-liquidation claim handling (`docs/plans/native-xlm-collateral-2026-10-27.md:86,89`). Frozen config and generic update denial prevent XLM admission now. No XLM claim, withdrawal, close, or liquidation payout lifecycle exists, and Cargo tests/build have not rerun after the route change.

cards.scope: Integrate Candid, user flows, and operator monitoring
cards.evidenceText: Candid regeneration passed with `RUMI_REGEN_DID=1 cargo +1.92.0 test --locked -p rumi_protocol_backend --bin rumi_protocol_backend check_candid_interface_compatibility -- --exact --nocapture`; `scripts/regenerate-declarations.sh rumi_protocol_backend` ran, and the non-regeneration compatibility test passed. No XLM vault, deposit, withdrawal, or claim endpoints or user flows are present. Keep interface and lifecycle work in progress.

cards.scope: Validate the rail with tests, independent review, and Stellar testnet evidence
cards.evidenceText: The last focused `chains::stellar` Cargo suite passed 34/34 and deposit-state migration test passed 1/1 before the final 10B cycle-budget edit and source route change in 011c0b72. Generic ICRC, redemption-candidate, SP quote/write-down, and main generic SP/3USD/bot fail-closed guards were reviewed at source level; Cargo tests/build have not rerun after that change. Independent review found no confirmed XRP regression, and V2 resume exact-journal continuation is unchanged. Remaining XRP-only withdrawal/close/manual-liquidation paths still fall through to ICRC if XLM becomes Active. Snapshot consistency and single-provider trust remain unresolved. No live XLM lifecycle, registration, deployment, or collateral admission is proved.

cards.scope: Prepare deployment, configuration, and activation evidence
cards.evidenceText: Blocked until implementation, exact-head review and CI, artifact verification, audit disposition, rollback and monitoring plans, and current Stellar oracle quorum, reserve, fee, provider, and key checks are evidenced. XRC XLM/USD live quorum is unproven. Deployment and activation remain separate proof points from signing, broadcasting, and moving funds.
